register.labelZh: KICK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: KICK 片語動詞也可以描述放鬆、反抗規則、開始活動,以及某種作用開始出現。；kick off 可以表示活動開始;kick in 可以表示機器、規則或藥物開始運作;kick up 則可以表示風勢增強。；kick somebody around 表示不公平地對待某人;kick somebody off 和 kick somebody out則可以描述把某人從服務、團體或地方移除。；你可以用 KICK 片語動詞描述把球踢來踢去、用腳踢開門、把鞋甩掉、把物件踢翻,以及揚起塵土。
register.summaryEn: KICK expressions can describe relaxing, resisting rules, starting events and beginning to feel an effect. Kick off shows that an event begins. Kick in shows that a machine, rule or medicine starts working. Kick up can show that the wind becomes stronger. Kick somebody around describes unfair treatment. Kick somebody off and kick somebody out describe different ways of removing a person from a service, group or place. You can use KICK expressions to talk about moving a ball, forcing a door open, removing shoes, knocking something over and raising dust.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Follow the word order shown in these examples: kick it around; kick them out; kick it over; kick her off the call. Similar-looking expressions can have very different meanings. For example, kick off can mean “begin”, while kick your shoes off means “remove them with your feet”.
